study type: Secondary analysis of a multicenter case-control study
exposure: second stage labor greater than 2 hours
Length of the second stage of labor
labor curve crossing the ACTION line of WHO's partogram
Cervical dilatation in the first stage of labor
cohort: Women with single, prior, low-transverse cesarean section who underwent a trial of labor (TOL)
finding: Labor dystocia, characterized by slower cervical dilation and longer labor duration, is a significant risk factor for uterine rupture in women with a prior cesarean section.
